# usgs-landscape-table

A ruled landscape table laid sideways on a portrait page (/Rotate 270): every header and row label runs bottom-to-top, with dotted leaders, two-level column headers and comma'd five-digit numerals. The rotation probe has only had synthetic coverage until now.
